brief:
A nine-month-old baby died from hypothermia inside his family's displacement tent in Gaza as winter conditions returned, Al Jazeera English reported. The child's death occurred as thousands of displaced families remain housed in tents with minimal protection from freezing temperatures.

Displacement camps across Gaza lack adequate shelter and heating resources. Many families have been forced from their homes amid the ongoing conflict and face severe hardship during winter months without sufficient means to keep warm.
dek: A nine-month-old baby has died from hypothermia inside his family’s displacement tent in Gaza, as winter returns.
title: Nine-month-old dies from cold in Gaza displacement tent
